integrity: Exact symbolic proof with elementary cyclotomic balance, affine Hessian determinant, and Galois field-of-definition argument. Small-case independent Python/SymPy checks are corroborative, not an all-parameter certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only odd primes, at least five coordinates, and characteristic zero. The cyclotomic etale spread-out need not equal the singular scheme of each positive-characteristic fiber. No claim of literature-wide uniqueness or independent verification.
title: Prime-cyclotomic nodes on diagonal Fermat hyperplane sections
